text: China's Sinopec — the China Petrochemical Corporation, a central state-owned enterprise listed by name in the State Council SASAC directory of central SOEs — closed a 10% acquisition of SIBUR in December 2015; SIBUR's latest disclosure (2024) lists Sinopec with 8.5% of SIBUR Holding.
short: China's state-owned Sinopec holds 8.5% of SIBUR Holding.

source.name: Interfax: SIBUR nearly doubles RAS profit to 166 bln rubles in 9M
source.quote: SIBUR's principal shareholders, according to the latest disclosure, are Leonid Mikhelson with 31%, Gennady Timchenko with 14.45%, China's Sinopec and Silk Road Fund with 8.5% each, Sogaz with 10.625%

additionalSources.name: TASS: Russia approves Silk Road Fund subsidiary purchasing 10% stake in Sibur
additionalSources.quote: In December 2015, Sinopec finalized the deal on acquiring a 10% stake in Sibur for $1.338 bln.

additionalSources.name: SASAC (国务院国资委) - 央企名录 (central state-owned enterprises directory)
additionalSources.quote: 中国石油化工集团有限公司
additionalSources.note: Translation: 'China Petrochemical Corporation (Sinopec Group)' — entry 12 in the directory, linking to sinopecgroup.com.
